statement.zh: Tibo 承诺：接下来的 28 天，每天推出一项对多数 Codex / Work 用户有用的明显改进，或进行一次完整额度重置。
statement.en: Tibo’s pledge: over 28 days, ship a clear improvement useful to most Codex / Work users each day, or a full quota reset.

body.zh: Tibo 宣布优化 GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 的默认速度，覆盖订阅中的各产品及使用 ChatGPT 登录的合作伙伴产品。用户无需操作；原帖预计改进会在随后两小时内逐步生效。
body.en: Tibo announced faster defaults for GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol across subscription products and partners using Sign in With ChatGPT. No user action is needed; the post expected rollout over the following two hours.

title.zh: Auto-review 免费且不占套餐用量
title.en: Auto-review is free with ChatGPT sign-in

body.zh: 通过 ChatGPT 账户登录的所有用户，现可免费使用 Auto-review，且该功能不消耗套餐用量。在输入框下方的权限菜单选择“Approve for me”，即可使用 Auto-review，为长任务中的操作增加复核。
body.en: Users who sign in with a ChatGPT account can use Auto-review without a charge against their subscription usage. Open the permissions menu below the composer and select “Approve for me” to review actions taken during longer tasks.

title.zh: API 用量等级简化为三档
title.en: API usage tiers simplified to three

body.zh: OpenAI API 的付费用量等级由五档简化为 Build、Launch、Grow 三档。最高档 Grow 的累计 API 付款门槛从 1,000 美元降至 500 美元，更容易获得更高请求速率限制。
body.en: OpenAI API paid usage tiers are simplified from five to three: Build, Launch, and Grow. The total API payment threshold for Grow, the highest tier, is reduced from $1,000 to $500, making it easier to qualify for higher rate limits.
